The handler returns the combined consumed width only when it exactly equals the declared payload length, otherwise zero. It does not modify the payload or destination.

On the native channel paths in AT-CHAT-001, the parser output is the message-builder source. The builders copy that prefix into their fixed message fields. A complete admitted fixed control included in this copied prefix reaches the message field unchanged. FUN_00445450 tests the copied input, not the replacement: 0x006FF724 loads the working local address before the call at 0x006FF72F.

A candidate within the tracked start/end interval advances the search beyond that end. Successful replacement adjusts later offsets by replacement length minus needle length.
